context: Run with Python 3, Icarus and Verilator in the workspace Linux environment. Copy run_iopl.py, aggregate_compat.py and audit_max.py into a fresh build/<fresh-run> directory first. Replace <fresh-run> below. The original launch.py records the superseded 300-second IOPL attempt and is not the final recipe.
independence: The first four commands are independent. Run the aggregate only after all four pass; run the MAX audit after the aggregate.
scope: The six IOPL profiles above 6 MHz have Verilator functional assertions without Icarus trace pairing. IOPL MAX/6 MHz and seven other banks have canonical dual trace comparisons. Every MAX pair uses complete raw stream SHA256, byte counts and row counts. No hardware historical pin-timing claim.
